description: Probability distribution calculator — Offline probability distributions: pdf/pmf, cdf, upper tail (sf), two-tailed p, quantiles (inverse cdf), interval probabilities, mean/variance/median, critical values. dist=normal (mean, sd) | t (df) | chi2 (df) | f (df1, df2) | binomial (n, prob) | poisson (lambda) | geometric (prob) | exponential (rate or scale) | uniform (min, max) | lognormal (meanlog, sdlog) | gamma (shape, scale or rate) | beta (a, b). x= one or more values (comma separated, max 50), p= probabilities for quantiles, between=a,b. No x/p gives the 90-99.5% critical values. Matches scipy.stats. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_distribution
